name: agent-workflow-migrator
description: Scaffold and sync the bundled Agent Workflow three-side knowledge-base setup into another vault, including cross-host migration.

interface.shortDescription: One-click migrate three-side workflow docs and scaffolds.
interface.longDescription: Copies the bundled Agent Workflow knowledge specs, AGENTS.md, agent configs, and project scaffolds into a target knowledge base so new repos or other hosts can reuse the same three-side setup quickly.
defaultPrompt: Migrate Agent Workflow scaffolds into another knowledge base.
Bootstrap AGENTS.md and .codex/agents in a new vault.
Sync Agent Workflow specs and project current docs.
